title: Turnal consenting installation analytics
scope_label: Directional pseudonymous data from consenting installations

source.count_rule: Command volume always sums the numeric count property; aggregate event rows are never command executions.
source.ordering_rule: Same-day milestones are an unordered set. No query establishes order within a UTC date.

weekly_recording_active.description: Distinct consenting installations with a completed recorded turn in the inclusive seven-date UTC window.
weekly_recording_active.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS recording_active_installations FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()

activated_installations.description: Date-level init plus validated adapter or wrapped-run milestone; same-day rows are unordered.
activated_installations.query: WITH milestones AS (SELECT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS event_date, maxIf(1, properties.metric = 'workspace.initialized') AS initialized, maxIf(1, properties.metric IN ('adapter.configured.claude', 'adapter.configured.codex', 'command.run.success')) AS configured FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false GROUP BY distinct_id, event_date), init AS (SELECT distinct_id, minIf(event_date, initialized = 1) AS init_date FROM milestones GROUP BY distinct_id) SELECT count(DISTINCT milestones.distinct_id) AS activated_installations FROM milestones INNER JOIN init ON milestones.distinct_id = init.distinct_id WHERE milestones.configured = 1 AND milestones.event_date >= init.init_date

d7_recording_retention.description: Activated installation with a recording metric exactly seven UTC dates after activation.
d7_recording_retention.query: WITH milestones AS (SELECT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS event_date, maxIf(1, properties.metric = 'workspace.initialized') AS initialized, maxIf(1, properties.metric IN ('adapter.configured.claude', 'adapter.configured.codex', 'command.run.success')) AS configured FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false GROUP BY distinct_id, event_date), init AS (SELECT distinct_id, minIf(event_date, initialized = 1) AS init_date FROM milestones GROUP BY distinct_id), activation AS (SELECT milestones.distinct_id AS distinct_id, min(milestones.event_date) AS activation_date FROM milestones INNER JOIN init ON milestones.distinct_id = init.distinct_id WHERE milestones.configured = 1 AND milestones.event_date >= init.init_date GROUP BY milestones.distinct_id), recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS record_date FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex')) SELECT count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT activation.distinct_id), 0) AS d7_recording_retention FROM activation LEFT JOIN recording ON activation.distinct_id = recording.distinct_id AND recording.record_date = activation.activation_date + 7 WHERE activation.activation_date <= today() - 7

d30_recording_retention.description: Activated installation with a recording metric exactly thirty UTC dates after activation.
d30_recording_retention.query: WITH milestones AS (SELECT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS event_date, maxIf(1, properties.metric = 'workspace.initialized') AS initialized, maxIf(1, properties.metric IN ('adapter.configured.claude', 'adapter.configured.codex', 'command.run.success')) AS configured FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false GROUP BY distinct_id, event_date), init AS (SELECT distinct_id, minIf(event_date, initialized = 1) AS init_date FROM milestones GROUP BY distinct_id), activation AS (SELECT milestones.distinct_id AS distinct_id, min(milestones.event_date) AS activation_date FROM milestones INNER JOIN init ON milestones.distinct_id = init.distinct_id WHERE milestones.configured = 1 AND milestones.event_date >= init.init_date GROUP BY milestones.distinct_id), recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id, toDate(properties.event_date) AS record_date FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex')) SELECT count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT activation.distinct_id), 0) AS d30_recording_retention FROM activation LEFT JOIN recording ON activation.distinct_id = recording.distinct_id AND recording.record_date = activation.activation_date + 30 WHERE activation.activation_date <= today() - 30

feature_adoption.description: Distinct installations using each successful public feature among weekly recording-active installations.
feature_adoption.query: WITH weekly_recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()), denominator AS (SELECT count() AS recording_active_installations FROM weekly_recording) SELECT properties.metric AS feature, count(DISTINCT events.distinct_id) AS feature_active_installations, any(denominator.recording_active_installations) AS recording_active_installations FROM events INNER JOIN weekly_recording ON events.distinct_id = weekly_recording.distinct_id CROSS JOIN denominator WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('command.log.success','command.sessions.success','command.show.success','command.search.success','command.diff.success','command.blame.success','command.rollback.success','command.replay.checkout.success','command.replay.move.success','command.replay.remove.success','command.run.success') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today() GROUP BY feature HAVING recording_active_installations >= 20

command_success_rate.description: Count-weighted reliability by canonical command family.
command_success_rate.query: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(properties.metric, '\.(success|failure)$', '') AS command_family, sumIf(toUInt64(properties.count), properties.metric LIKE '%.success') AS successes, sumIf(toUInt64(properties.count), properties.metric LIKE '%.failure') AS failures, successes / nullIf(successes + failures, 0) AS success_rate FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric LIKE 'command.%' GROUP BY command_family

adapter_mix.description: Installation adoption and aggregate completed-turn count by adapter.
adapter_mix.query: SELECT properties.metric AS adapter, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS installations, sum(toUInt64(properties.count)) AS completed_turns FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') GROUP BY adapter HAVING installations >= 20

active_version_share.description: Weekly active installation mix by released version.
active_version_share.query: SELECT properties.turnal_version AS turnal_version, count(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS active_installations FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_daily_active' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today() GROUP BY turnal_version HAVING active_installations >= 20 ORDER BY active_installations DESC

weekly_recording_active_trend.description: Daily trailing-seven-date recording-active installations with a four-week moving average.
weekly_recording_active_trend.query: WITH dates AS (SELECT arrayJoin(range(28)) AS offset, today() - offset AS report_date), daily AS (SELECT dates.report_date AS report_date, count(DISTINCT events.distinct_id) AS weekly_recording_active FROM dates LEFT JOIN events ON event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(events.properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND events.properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude', 'turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(events.properties.event_date) BETWEEN dates.report_date - 6 AND dates.report_date GROUP BY report_date) SELECT report_date, weekly_recording_active, avg(weekly_recording_active) OVER (ORDER BY report_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS four_week_moving_average FROM daily ORDER BY report_date

inspection_share.description: Weekly inspecting-active installations divided by weekly recording-active installations.
inspection_share.query: WITH recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude','turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()), inspecting AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('command.log.success','command.sessions.success','command.show.success','command.search.success','command.diff.success','command.blame.success') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()) SELECT count(DISTINCT inspecting.distinct_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id), 0) AS inspection_share FROM recording LEFT JOIN inspecting ON recording.distinct_id = inspecting.distinct_id HAVING count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id) >= 20

recovery_share.description: Weekly recovery-active installations divided by weekly recording-active installations.
recovery_share.query: WITH recording AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('turn.recorded.claude','turn.recorded.codex') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()), recovery AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false AND properties.metric IN ('command.rollback.success','command.replay.checkout.success','command.replay.move.success','command.replay.remove.success') AND toDate(properties.event_date) BETWEEN today() - 6 AND today()) SELECT count(DISTINCT recovery.distinct_id) / nullIf(count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id), 0) AS recovery_share FROM recording LEFT JOIN recovery ON recording.distinct_id = recovery.distinct_id HAVING count(DISTINCT recording.distinct_id) >= 20

activation_conversion_by_version.description: Date-level initialized and activated installation counts by release version; no ordered same-day funnel.
activation_conversion_by_version.query: WITH milestones AS (SELECT distinct_id, properties.turnal_version AS turnal_version, toDate(properties.event_date) AS event_date, maxIf(1, properties.metric = 'workspace.initialized') AS initialized, maxIf(1, properties.metric IN ('adapter.configured.claude','adapter.configured.codex','command.run.success')) AS configured FROM events WHERE event = 'turnal_metric' AND coalesce(properties.collector_canary, false) = false GROUP BY distinct_id, turnal_version, event_date), init AS (SELECT distinct_id, min(event_date) AS init_date, argMin(turnal_version, event_date) AS init_version FROM milestones WHERE initialized = 1 GROUP BY distinct_id), activation AS (SELECT milestones.distinct_id AS distinct_id, min(milestones.event_date) AS activation_date FROM milestones INNER JOIN init ON milestones.distinct_id = init.distinct_id WHERE milestones.configured = 1 AND milestones.event_date >= init.init_date GROUP BY milestones.distinct_id) SELECT init.init_version AS turnal_version, count(DISTINCT init.distinct_id) AS initialized_installations, count(DISTINCT activation.distinct_id) AS activated_installations, activated_installations / nullIf(initialized_installations, 0) AS activation_rate FROM init LEFT JOIN activation ON init.distinct_id = activation.distinct_id GROUP BY turnal_version HAVING initialized_installations >= 20

operational_sources.schema_rejection_rate: collector HTTP counters grouped only by released client version
operational_sources.outbox_delivery_health: collector state counts, oldest pending age, and synthetic canary reconciliation
operational_sources.accepted_volume_anomaly: collector accepted daily batch count with a five-times baseline alert
